integrity: Within each peripheral clique, twin symmetry allows at most one omitted vertex. For an omitted peripheral vertex, the number of distance-one landmarks is its clique order minus one, plus one if the center is selected; hence omitted vertices from different cliques collide exactly when those clique orders are equal. An omitted center has an all-one representation and is separated from every omitted peripheral vertex by a selected distance-two landmark in another nontrivial clique. The product enumerator follows by independent choices across distinct clique-order classes.
scientific_limitations: All peripheral clique orders are at least two.
The published uniform generalized-windmill scalar value is prior work and is recovered as a specialization.
The new claim is the variable-size all-set classification, product enumerator, dimension formula, and minimum-basis count.
Finite exhaustive verification through peripheral order ten is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed variable-size clique-bouquet treatment may exist.
title: Outer multiset resolving sets of heterogeneous windmills
